result.summary: Found 2 visual inconsistencies: missing background on one favorite button in Popular right now, and vertical misalignment plus inconsistent time-badge inset in the Fastest near you carousel.

issues.description: Favorite heart button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in Popular right now lacks the dark circular translucent background that is present on the pizza card below it, leaving a bare white outline icon with lower contrast and inconsistent appearance.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same dark circular scrim/background container to all favorite buttons for visual consistency and legibility over imagery

issues.description: Cards in the Fastest near you carousel are not vertically aligned to a common top baseline - the Smash Bros Burgers image sits lower than the Green Bowl Poke image - and the 20-30 min time pill on the middle card sits flush/overflowing at the left image edge versus inset padding on the adjacent cards.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to the same top offset and use consistent internal inset padding for the delivery-time pills so they do not touch or overflow the image bounds
